notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Update 1.16 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]
[list]
[b][*] Season 4 will begin on February 20, 2024[/b]
[list]
[*] A new Season Pass will be added, and the Shop lineup will be redesigned.
[/list][*] New ★5 title Frostbane and new Ultskill Ice Minigun for Mages.
[list]
[*] The caster unleashes a relentless volley of ice bullets to suppress enemies with overwhelming firepower.
[/list][*] The Deploy Point System will now be the official System for Deploying Characters in Warlander.
[list]
[*] Deploy Points are obtained over time, when a certain number of Valor points are earned, or when the core of your army is attacked. Under this system, players will use those points to launch a character with a high Title Rank.
[*] Changes since the last Deploy Point system preview:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the amount of Deploy Points required for Characters of each Title Rank.
[list]
[*] V1: 50
[*] V2: 150 → 100
[*] V3: 300 → 200
[*] V4: 600 → 400
[*] V5: 1200 → 1500
[/list][*] Adjusted the number of the Deploy Point bonus from earning Valor points.
[list]
[*] 1000 VP: 10 → 20 Deploy Points
[*] 2000 VP: 20 → 40 Deploy Points
[*] 3000 VP: 30 → 60 Deploy Points
[*] 4000 VP: 40 → 80 Deploy Points
[*] 5000 VP: 50 → 100 Deploy Points
[*] Every additional 1000 VP after 5000: 60→120 Deploy Points.
[/list][/list][*] With the introduction of the Deploy Point system, the previous system that raises the Valor Points earned when defeating an enemy of higher Title Rank will be removed.
[*] This was implemented at the time of the last Deploy Point system preview, but went unmentioned in official channels. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
[/list][*] Added episode 4 "The Warlords" to the Chronicle.
[*] Added the ability to purchase unpurchased Glamours and other items from the customization screen.
[*] Added feature to see what items are for sale in the Cosmetics tab when logging in.
[*] Added feature that displays an icon in the Shop tab when an update is made.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The maximum number of players who can achieve Aura Rank will be 100 starting this season.
[*] Improved Dawn Bridge B.
[list]
[*] Matching with Dawn Bridge A, the following actions were taken:
[list]
[*] Lanes were better separated from each other to emphasize the role of each lane.
[*] Doors were added to each lane to increase the amount of back and forth gameplay.
[/list][*] Adjustments were made near the center of the stage to allow for a different strategies than Dawn Bridge A by placing a stone bridge connecting the north and south lanes.
[*] Other adjustments have been made to the stage throughout.
[*] We will continue to make improvements to maps.
[/list][*] The strategy selection screen will be removed from 2-team battles.
[list]
[*] This is the screen where Offense, Defense, or Balanced strategy is selected through voting. It was removed in order to improve the tempo of the game and because Balance was selected in the majority of Battles.
[*] This will also reduce the waiting time on the role selection screen.
[/list][*] We have made improvements to Bots, reducing the number of times a Bot hits a seemingly distant Bot due to lag.
[*] Adjustments will be made to the Battle record information used for matchmaking and will now be based on a wider variety of factors.
[*] Shop: change so that unowned items are prioritized for sale within the first 3 pages of the Cosmetics tab and elsewhere.
[list]
[*] When you purchase an item within the first 3 pages, it will automatically be replaced by another item that you do not yet own.
[/list][*] The Squad Respawn system will be removed.
[list]
[*] We had hoped that Squad Respawn would encourage teamwork within Squads, but we decided to remove it because it obscured frontline tactics by affecting the number of players on the front line and allowed players who could communicate to make better use of their resources than other players.
[/list][*] The Stormbringer Ult Skill "Thunderstorm" now grants 10 protection per second to the caster when used.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused rocket punches to rarely hit Cores and Robots.
[*] Fixed a bug in 5-Army Battles that allowed players on allied armies to use Execute on each other.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Protection skill and Harvest Dance Ult Skill’s protection-granting effects would also work on players on allied armies.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Power Bomb Skill to deal back damage even if the attack was not from the rear.
[*] Fixed an issue where attacking with Power Bomb or Finishers would kill the user while standing still when lag was very high.
[*] Fixed a bug in Labyrinth Temple that would not allow markers to be placed on the map screen.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
[h1]Maintenance Notice[/h1]
Maintainance will be performed from around from around 8:30 am Tuesday, Feb 20 to around 9:00 am (UTC)

Please note that you will not be able to access the game during maintenance.

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Update 1.15.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Alternate Deploy Point System—Preview 2
[list]

[*] With this system, characters consume "Deploy points," which are different from traditional Valor points, when they Re-Deploy.
[*] The higher the Title Rank of a character, the more Deploy points required.
[*] This is a preview of this system which means we will collect data and feedback before finalizing the decision on whether we stay with this system or revert to the original system.
[*] Deploy Point acquisition has been improved since the last preview. Deploy Points can be increased in three ways:
[list]

[*] Over Time
[list]

[*] Obtain the following number of points at 10-second intervals:
[*] 0-180s: 10 points per 10s
[*] 181-360s: 20 points per 10s
[*] 361-540s: 30 points per 10s
[*] 541-720s: 40 points per 10s
[*] 721 to 900s: 50 points per 10s
[*] During Overtime: 60 points per 10s
[/list][/list]
[list]
[*] When your Core is damaged
[list]

[*] 30 points for every 100 damage inflicted to your Core
[/list][/list]
[list]
[*] Earn a certain amount of Valor Points (VP)
[list]

[*] 1000 VP earned: 10 points
[*] 2000 VP earned: 20 points
[*] 3000 VP earned: 30 points
[*] 4000 VP earned: 40 points
[*] 5000 VP earned: 50 points
[*] After that, 60 points for every additional 1000 VP earned.
[/list][/list][/list]
[list]
[*] The amount of Deploy Points required to produce each title rank is as follows.
[list]

[*] Title Rank 1: 50
[*] Title Rank 2: 150
[*] Title Rank 3: 300
[*] Title Rank 4: 600
[*] Title Rank 5: 1200
[/list][/list]
[*] Added a new basic action: Execute
[list]

[*] Can be used on a downed opponent by pressing and holding the F key/Square button/X button.
[*] A character that has been "Executed" cannot be revived without re-deploying and is penalized by having its Deploy Cost increased.
[list]

[*] A character with Title Rank 0 will not be penalized for being Executed.
[/list]
[*] The penalty will be removed once the Executed character is Deployed again.
[*] The increase in Deploy Cost depends on the character's Title Rank.
[*] Finishers for Warriors and Clerics will also have the same effect as Execute.
[list]

[*] Valor points earned during Finisher will be changed from 200 to 50.
[/list][/list]
[*] Improved Dawn Bridge A map
[list]

[*] We are now making improvements to Dawn Bridge A to solve two major problems:
[list]

[*] Doors that need to be destroyed are placed at the connecting passage between lanes.
[list]

[*] Currently, once a lane was breached, it was possible to move immediately to another lane. This obscured the role of each lane and made it difficult to push back because once one lane was invaded, all lanes could be penetrated.
[/list]
[*] 2. Additional gates must be broken through in all lanes
[list]

[*] Currently, there are few steps to push and pull in each lane, making it difficult to understand the front line and making the siege experience pale in comparison.
[/list][/list]
[*] Other adjustments have been made to the map throughout.
[*] We will continue to make improvements to this and other maps in the future.
[/list]
[*] New "Special Effects" added.
[list]

[*] You can set the effects that are displayed for your footsteps, upon death, and when warping.
[*] Can be set from the customization screen.
[*] Special Effects can be purchased in the store with Silvings.
[/list]
[*] Added anonymous display feature for content creators.
[list]
[*] All other player names can now be hidden with the exception of yourself and your party members.
[*] This can be set from the options screen.
[*] Only supported on Steam and PS5.
[/list]
[*] Added more tips for the loading screen.
[*] Add spectator feature to Custom Battles.
[list]

[*] Allows you to participate in Custom Battles as a spectator.
[/list]
[*] Added player account system PROS.
[list]

[*] Be the first to know what's new in Warlander by registering your email address.
[*] You can register an account from the support screen in game.
[*] Register an account to receive the following rewards.
[list]

[*] Warrior Epic Equipment x2
[*] Cleric Epic Equipment x2
[*] Mage Epic Equipment x2
[*] Character EXP Booster x5
[*] Reward Volume Booster x5
[/list][/list]
[*] New Chronicles added to Movies.
[list]

[*] EP3 The False World and The Trials
[/list]
[*] Add SE when using response voice macro
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]
[list]

[*] When re-deploying at the castle, you will be able to choose one of several locations.
[*] Valor Points can now be earned by destroying enemy Idols.
[*] The shape of the roof of the battering ram after enhancement has been adjusted to make it more difficult for bullets from the front to pass through.
[*] Adjustments will be made to the Cleric skill Resurrection.
[list]

[*] The CP and Cooldown (CD) have been decreased to make the skill easier to use, while the percentage of HP granted when reviving an ally has been decreased as the effect of reviving an ally with high HP has too great an impact on battle. The ability to revive from a distance also frequently made it difficult to understand who revived who, so the range will also be reduced.
[*] CP: 45/60/110/155/175⇒30/50/70/90/110
[*] CD: 120/90/49/34/30⇒30/28/26/24/22
[*] HP percentage at revival (%): 100⇒ Per Skill Level 20/30/40/50/60
[*] Range (m): 30⇒20
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which the cooldown for team skills only advanced upon death.
[*] Perk: Fixed a bug where the effect of Jump Attack Power UP was not expressed in %.
[*] Fixed a bug where the oil jar could not be activated immediately after grabbing it.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs
[/list]

notes.title: 🌟 Customization Campaign! 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/6a20cc0ad798433107a087ab4c845476c00bcfed.png[/img]

As part of Warlander's 1st-anniversary project, we will be holding a Customization Campaign!

The chosen custom characters will be implemented in the game as Glamour Bundles and Mercenary Contracts!

The final candidates will be selected by the development team for the community to vote on.

We can't wait to see what you create!


[h2]Overview[/h2]
During December we collected your custom Mercenary Contracts which you will soon be able to see in the game!

We loved seeing your submissions and will for Warlander’s 1st anniversary be doing it again and this time you can submit Glamour Bundles!

You may submit either or both, but please only submit one character per category.

(e.g. you may submit 1 Cleric in the Glamour category and 1 Mage in the Build category)

The final candidates will be selected by the development team, and the community will vote on the winners from those candidates.

[h3]Times (UTC)[/h3]
9:00 am Thursday, Jan 25, 2024 - 2:59 pm Monday, Feb 5, 2024 
9:00 am Friday, Feb 12, 2024 - 2:59 pm Monday, Feb 19, 2024

The winners are expected to be implemented in-game in March or April 2024

Post screenshots of your glamour combinations as displayed in images (1), (2), and (3) from the customization screen of your submission in the official Discord campaign thread for the Community Glamour Channel.

[list][*] Raised durability of the Battering Ram

notes.title: ⚔️ Warlander Update 1.13.0 ⚔️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Game Mode: Union War! Separate into player groups called Unions and aim for the top of the leaderboards.
[list]
[*] First, this will be introduced in a preview event three times a day (4:00 am/2:00 pm/9:00 pm UTC) from Nov 28 to Dec 12.
[*] Each player sets a Union Tag. Players with matching Union Tags are considered to be in the same union.
[list]
[*] Players with the same Union Tag are more likely to be matched in the same Battle and on the same Army.
[*] During the preview event, you can only select from preset Unions.
[/list]
[*] Each player earns rank points from Battle results. The overall Union Ranking is determined by Union Points which are calculated from the rank points earned by each player belonging to the union.
[*] Union ranking is determined by the sum of all members' rank points, and each player's rank is multiplied by a multiplier (influence coefficient) according to his/her rank in the members' ranking.
[list]
[*] Members ranked 1~10 within their Union have their points tripled, while those ranked 101st and below have their points multiplied by 0.1. This means that even a union with a relatively small number of members may be able to compete with a union with a large number of members depending on the performance of its top members!
[/list][/list]
[*] The point system for Deploying Characters with high-ranking Titles will be changed.
[list]
[*] When a character respawns, this will cost Deploy Points.
[*] Deploy points increase over time; the later in the Battle, the more points obtained.
[*] Deploy points also increase when your Army’s Core is damaged. 
[*] A preview event for this mode will be held on the following dates (all times in UTC):
[list]
[*] 9:00 am November 28 to 8:59 am December 1
[*] 9:00 am December 2 to 8:59 am December 4
[/list]
[*] Major Change to Battle Rules
[list]
[*] The current system, which allows players to Deploy Characters with higher Title Ranks earlier by earning Valor Points, frequently resulted in the team that won the battle early on by Deploying Characters with high ranked Titles, causing the development of the game to become one-sided. Furthermore, the actions that lead to victory change depending on the situation, which makes it difficult to create a comprehensive evaluation system for earning Valor Points. This new system awards point over time, making it easier to formulate strategies for which character to Deploy at which point in time. We also hope that this system will make it easier for comebacks to occur by awarding points to Armies that have taken damage to their Cores.
[/list][/list]
[*] New Squad Respawn System
[list]
[*] You will now be able to Warp/respawn at a Squad Member's location to make it easier to act as part of a Squad.
[*] However, a Squad Warp or Squad respawn cannot occur under the following conditions:
[list]
[*] When the target Squad member is in an enemy keep
[*] When the target Squad member is near an enemy
[/list][/list]
[*] New Mage skill: Snow Vortex
[list]
[*] A violent whirlwind of snow that inflicts ice damage and freezes enemies in range.
[/list]
[*] A sound effect now plays when Protection is lost due to an enemy attack.
[*] In order to open room for more varied Mage Titles, and to make the Titles more consistent with their characteristics, Title names, unlock conditions, and characteristics of some Mage Titles will be changed.
[list]
[*] Warrior Titles
[list]
[*] Hitman: Backstab Power +3.75%
[*] Assassin: Backstab Power +5.62%
[*] Nightblade: Backstab Power +7.5%
[/list]
[*] Cleric Titles
[list]
[*] Nurse: Rescue Speed +16%
[*] Chirurgeon: Rescue Speed +24%
[*] Savior: Rescue Speed +32%
[/list]
[*] Mage Titles
[list]
[*] Tamer: Familiar Cooldown -2%
[*] Summoner: Familiar Cooldown -4%
[*] Conjurer: Familiar Cooldown -6%
[*] Spiritcaller: Familiar Cooldown -8%
[*] Occultist: Familiar Attack Power +5%
[*] Diabolist: Familiar Attack Power +7.5%
[*] Demon Ruler: Familiar Attack Power +10%
[/list][/list]
[*] New talents will be added.
[list]
[*] Enhanced Backstrike
[*] Servant Cooldown Down
[*] Aim Move Speed Up
[/list]
[*] Tips will be added on the loading screen. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] As Perks with continuous effects (such as those that boost max HP) are no longer affected by the Cleric Skill Dispel as this allows players to gain Valor points multiple times.
[*] It will now be possible to activate the Cleric Skill Warp Gate even if another warp gate created by a member of the same Squad exists on the battlefield.
[list]
[*] If triggered, other warp gates created by Squad mates will be destroyed.
[/list]
[*] The performance of Warp Gate has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Warp Gate will be made easier to use by adjusting the cooldown and cast time. The duration will also be adjusted so that it is recognized as a target that can be destroyed.
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 30s→20s
[*] Cast time: 6s→3s
[*] Duration: 25/30/35/40/45⇒60/90/120/150/180
[/list][/list]
[*] The performance of Holy Protection has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Due to the lower effectiveness and decreased usage of Holy Protection compared to other abilities, adjustments will be made to enhance its effects. Simultaneously, to clearly define Holy Protection's role in supporting allied players, the Additional Armor granted to oneself will be half of the regular effect.
[list]
[*] Additional Armor: 10/20/30/40/50→20/40/60/80/100
[*] The Additional Armor granted to oneself is halved
[list]
[*] If Harvest Dance's Additional Armor is also granted to oneself, the effect is halved
[/list][/list][/list]
[*] The performance of Whirlwind has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Adjustments will be made to Whirlwind as its damage output was low compared to CP and skill cooldown times.
[list]
[*] CP: 45/60/110/155/175 → 30/60/100/115/125
[/list]
[*] Attack: 10/10.75/13.25/15.5/16.5 → 15/17.25/20.25/21.38/22.12
[*] Demolition: 10/10.75/13.25/15.5/16.5 → 15/17.25/20.25/21.38/22.12
[/list]
[*] The performance of Ice Spear has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] By combining it with other ice attribute skills, Freeze values will be added to enhance its effectiveness.
[*] When the Freeze value reaches a certain level, it will enter a frozen state.
[/list]
[*] The performance of Ice Missile has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] By combining it with other ice attribute skills, Freeze values will be added to enhance its effectiveness.
[*] When the Freeze value reaches a certain level, it will enter a frozen state.
[*] As a result, adjustments to the damage amount and cooldown will be made.
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 11s→13s
[*] Attack: 25→20
[*] Demolition: 25→20
[/list][/list]
[*] The performance of Fire Wall has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Previously, there was no warning when activating Fire Wall, and players had limited ways to deal with it. Therefore, we will change it to provide a warning before the activation of Fire Wall. Additionally, we have enhanced the burning effect, reduced the slowing effect, added an impact on physical entities, and extended the activation range, making it more user-friendly.
[list]
[*] CP: 20/35/75/110/125 ⇒ 15/30/45/60/75
[*] Demolition: 0→20
[*] Warning signs have been added
[*] Adjusted to ignite more quickly
[*] Placement range: 25m→35m
[*] Slowing effect: 80%→30%
[/list][/list]
[*] The performance of Wave Blaster has been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Due to the small size of low-level Wave Blasters making effective use difficult, size adjustments will be made. Additionally, since the attackable time after staggering was short, stagger duration will be adjusted.
[list]
[*] Size (m):1.5/2.34/2.52/2.58/2.62⇒2/2.46/2.56/2.59/2.62
[*] Increased stagger duration
[/list][/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused warp gates to remain in the air if the location where the warp gate was installed was destroyed.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the range of dash slashes to be greater than normal in rare cases.
[*] The bug that caused the victory camera to malfunction under certain conditions on Dawn Bridge B has been fixed.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

notes.title: ✨ Q & A Part 1 ✨
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

Welcome to part 1 of the community Q & A! Get ready for Part 2 next season!

[h3]Q: Will there be ways to save equipment setups?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] While we understand that having to recreate your character setup every time you create a new character. Making a system to Save and copy existing character setups would require significant development time. This is something we might revisit in the future.

[h3]Q: Has there been any consideration to allow us to change the default ranged weapon?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Assuming you wish to have a Crossbow other than an assault crossbow as a weapon when no other Crossbow is equipped, this is under consideration.

[h3]Q: When making balance changes to the game, what are the factors being considered when making them, what portion of the player base (if any) is being studied or consulted going into these changes, and can we expect less frequent but large-scale balance passes like this again or more frequent, smaller scale balance passes instead?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We make balance adjustments based on feedback from within the team and from players, as well as from information gathered through testing. In addition, while we have been making large-scale balance adjustments in the past, we believe that it would be ideal to make smaller-scale balance adjustments more frequently in the future.

[h3]Q: The high damage, perfect accuracy, and damage falloff values of Magic Arrow at current make it in almost all cases the best choice for any range engagement. Its ease of use makes it a better choice for most players even in engagements where an Ice Spear user should have the advantage. Is Magic Arrow overperforming, is Ice Spear underperforming, or are they both where the team wants them to be?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Thank you for your input, Even within the development team, we feel that the Magic Arrow is too versatile, which is a challenge in terms of customization diversity. At the start of Season 3, adjustments have been made to the Magic Arrow's performance, such as reducing its long-range advantage, while retaining its characteristic rapid-firing speed as a feature.

[h3]Q: How often can we expect to see balance changes within Warlander?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We will be doing small balance changes running through the seasons. As soon as we see the need to update the balancing in the game we will prepare it.

[h3]Q: New players are feeling steamrolled by experienced players with a lot of items. Any plans on improving the experience for new players?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] This is a top priority. We have taken action to completely isolate new player matchmaking during the first 20 battles. We will also make some titles easier to obtain to alleviate the equipment gap, and in Season 3, we will also increase the number of items and skills that new players will have from the start.
We will continue to make improvements to make it easier for new players to enter the game.

[h3]Q: What are your plans to balance wizards? they are by far the most played class and strongest. they diffidently have the most impact on the game.[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We have received a lot of feedback on the performance of the Mage. We are currently in the process of organizing player and team feedback and developing a plan for adjustments. We plan to make adjustments in Season 3.

[h3]Q: Will there be more gold events in the future for our free-to-play friends?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Events with Goldings as rewards will be held on a regular basis.

[h3]Q: How do you intend on incentivizing us to invest into cosmetics and battlepasses moving forward?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We will continue to create more and new exciting items and cosmetics for everyone to enjoy! There's a lot more to come!

[h3]Q: Are there any plans on possibly introducing class-specific loot rewards possibly a daily or just a portion of the drops you recovered aimed at the class you played that match?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We like this idea and are discussing internally better way to improve getting new drops and equipment. Nothing concrete has been planned yet.

[h3]Q: Are you planning on adding some bonus loot for people who already completed the season pass? F.e. you get a random mythic item for every 250k xp you earn on top of lvl 100. It gives players an incentive to keep logging on daily to do the daily/weekly challenges.[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We're working on retention and systems to incentivize people to play the game after completing the Battle Pass as well as early on in the seasons. Making the levels keep going is something that's brought up internally.

[h3]Q: Are there any plans to increase the inventory space?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] With the last update, inventory expansion packs are now available for sale in Goldings. Please consider purchasing them from the Shop.

[h3]Q: Will the cleric class ever expect to receive a gap closer / distance-making ability? Especially with the reduction to the speed stat, the argument that cleric has access to the fastest speed titles as their initiator/escape tool holds little weight when one considers the availability of health now and what you sacrifice by not taking an HP-based title and build.[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Clerics are designed as a class that can provide a variety of support, so it is possible that skills specific to mobility will be implemented in the future.

[h3]Q: Are custom matches only planned for events?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] At this time, it is planned to be used exclusively for events. This could potentially change in the future.

[h3]Q: Are there any plans to release a setting to reduce confusion for people who are colorblind in the future?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] It will be supported and is currently in the process of being implemented.

[h3]Q: Are there any plans for Twitch drops?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We want to do Twitch drops and are currently trying to get the game to a great spot before introducing this.

[h3]Q: What do you intend to do to keep a more casual gameplay experience and to keep new players interested?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We will address the concerns of the players. This includes improving the Matchmaking system to prevent new players from being killed by veterans. And Increase the quality of the game loop with new skills, maps, etc. We're also planning to give more incentives to play the game beyond The battle pass. 

Recently, we have implemented cross-party and voice chat so that more people can enjoy the game.

[h3]Q: 5 army battle mode is good and very hard to win, do you have plans to include it in the ranking by giving points to the team depending on the place they finish?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] There are no concrete plans at this time, but it is possible that a system could be implemented or similar in the future.

[h3]Q: When will we be able to communicate with our squad that we solo queue up for, as I think that it would be interesting to have proximity chat with your squad and other friendly squads near you, allowing squads team up and make the current playstyle a little more tactical.[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] In-game voice chat has been implemented.

Voice chat is only available between users who have configured their settings to allow voice chat.

[h3]Q: Wil Warlander be on PS4/Xbox One?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] There are currently no plans for a previous gen console version of Warlander.

[h3]Q: Will there be cross platform parties?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Cross-party was implemented in Season 2! Players from different platforms can party with each other.

[h3]Q: Will there be a character with a horse and who advances with a spear?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We are not planning to do this at this time, as the inclusion of a character with extremely high mobility could significantly upset the balance of the game.

[h3]Q: Are there any plans to expand on the commander role? And how?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Our plans for the commander is to first simplify the role so it's easier to understand. Afterwards we will expand what the Commander can do and their responsibilities to make them feel more impactful on the battlefield

[h3]Q: Would it be possible for us to be able to stay in the main menu while searching for a match to look at the map, change some equipment?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] This is not currently planned due to system reasons, but will be considered.

[h3]Q: Is there a possibility, and if so a plan, to enable reconnecting to a game you've been disconnected from?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Due to the complexity of the network system thanks to elements such as object destruction, there are currently no plans to implement a feature that would allow re-connection to the game.

[h3]Q: Do you plan to add more ice spells to the mage other than the ice spear we already have?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Recently, Ice Missile has been implemented for Mages.

[h3]Q: Is it possible to expect a new rarity named "Unique" and in that rarity it would have to more fun styled weapons that Happy Wars had? Such as chainsaw swords, the moonlight blades, cat paw staffs etc...[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] More interesting item and weapon designs just like Happy Wars are coming! They will not have a special Rarity though.

[h3]Q: Will the AI allies/enemies receive any updates to their AI, equipment or other additions to make them a more formidable foe?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We're monitoring the performance of bots in the game and making sure that they fill out the battlefield and can't be ignored. While keeping them at a level where new players doesn't feel helpless against them.

[h3]Q: Is there any intention to increase focus on squad goals? Potentially by increasing valor for tasks that are the responsibility of that squad for that squad?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Yes, we are testing various measures to make it easier to act in squads. We are testing various measures to make it easier to act in squads. We are still testing them, but we hope to be able to show you all in the near future.

[h3]Q: How do you feel about having an option for players to vote against getting a specific role? (current system is players can raise hand to vote for it but even if 3 don't want the role and 1 player does, if no one else on the team votes that 1 player pulls the squad)[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] This is an interesting idea, we will consider it.

[h3]Q: Is there any plan to equalize valor between players that farm points and disregard squad goals and players that focus on squad goals even at the cost of their own valor?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] This is a point we are frequently discussing internally. We plan to improve it so that players who are more aware of their squad roles and contribute to the victory are better appreciated.

[h3]Q: Is the plan to allow separate queues for players that want to play solo vs squads? (Queues that both allow drops and rank progression)[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We are considering it. We are cautious about implementing this system because if we include it, it may not be possible to matchmake for large groups.

[h3]Q: Any cool events planned for the future?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We are planning more regular events in the future. Please look forward to them!

[h3]Q: Could we have our team enter same wait lobby practice area? Would love to be in a training lobby with my friends so we can hangout pregame. Is this possible in the future?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Under consideration. Likely to be implemented in the future.

[h3]Q: Do you plan to implement a way that I can play with more than 3 friends at a time in any capacity?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We have plans of a Event in the future we're naming "Union War" which will increase the likelihood of friends getting into the same battle using tags. More about this will be revealed when ready.

[h3]Q: Do you plan on adding a way to repair an object while its on fire or put a fire out either but a nearby bucket or water spell or anything of the kind?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] This Idea has been brought up several times within the development team. Our core concern for this feature is that it will increase match times, and could make some fronts too difficult to breach. The conversation is ongoing and might be added in the future if we feel we can make it work.

[h3]Q: Weaponizing the report system is a well-known issue in many other games. Players mass report the enemy team’s key members to get them banned. Are there any popular solutions among the staff to solve this before it grows into a common WL issue?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] Regarding cheats, if we detect any program or memory tampering, we ban those cheaters immediately. However, for reports from users, we try to investigate first. Therefore, we do not ban for mass reporting or false reporting.

[h3]Q: Is there a timeline on fixing the terrain issue with wind blast disappearing?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] The team is aware of the issue and is taking steps to mitigate it as needed. We will continue to work on corrective actions.

[h3]Q: If some of the devs partied up and queued for a 2 army, what role are they picking and what classes/titles are they going with?[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] There is no specific popular build, as each person on the development team has a different play style. The director likes to destroy anti-siege weapons, so he often builds Characters that specialize in destroying objects before joining the assault team.

[h3]Q: Are there any considerations regarding the removal of insignificant buffs and talents such as +0.15% movement speed or +1.25% fire damage? These additions contribute very little value to a character.[/h3]

[b]A:[/b] We currently have no plans to remove these, as Talents are intended to be effective when multiple instances of the same type of Talent are equipped. There is a possibility we may adjust the balance of certain Talents.

notes.title: ⚔️ Season 3 Patch Notes! ver. 1.12.0.1556 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Season 3 will begin November 21, 2023!
[list]

[*] The New Season Passes have been added and the Shop, and the overall Shop lineup has been redesigned.
[list]

[*] The number of equipment Glamours for each class available with the Premium Season Pass has been increased from Season 2.

[*] The price of the Premium Season Pass has been changed from 1820 Goldings to 2050 Goldings.
[/list]
[*] Each menu screen and Title logo will be revamped for Season 3.
[list]

[*] The top header and general menu background have been changed to a blue background, and the pattern has been updated.

[*] Changed the background model of the top menu.
[/list]
[*] Changed the game logo on the title screen.
[/list]
[*] New ★5 Cleric Title: Harvest Queen.
[list]

[*] New Ult Skill, Harvest Dance: Spray fruit around yourself to strengthen nearby allies. Sometimes rare glowing fruit will also appear. These sport increased effect.
[list]

[*] Apples: Boosts attack.

[*] Muscats：Boosts movement speed.

[*] Corn: Apply protection effect.
[/list][/list]
[*] New 2-Army Battle Map: Labyrinth Temple
[list]

[*] This underground labyrinth stage includes new elements such as movable siege weapons, pitfalls, and moving floors!
[/list]
[*] Added new Tips to the loading screen.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] All starting skills through level 4 are now accessible to new players. This is to make it easier for players to utilize high rank Titles as soon as they get them. 

[*] The restriction on purchasing skills on the Shop screen has been removed. Players can now purchase as many skills as they want as long as they have enough Silvings.

[*] Meteor Cataclysm adjusted.

[list]
[*] The area of effect when the Meteor Cataclysm is triggered has been adjusted so that it is more concentrated in a rectangular area in front of where it was invoked.

[*] The interval between invoking the Meteor Cataclysm and the meteors falling has been shortened. 
[/list]
[*] Robot Cataclysm improved. 

[list]
[*] Increased the damage of melee attacks.

[*] The rapid fire gatling gun ranged weapon has had its damage and travel decay improved to give the Robot better ranged combat capabilities. 

[*] Adjusted the camera to make it easier to shoot when piloting the machine gun and cannon.
[/list]
[*] The Cleric skill "Warp Gate" can no longer be activated on siege towers because the gate remains in the air even when the tower moves away. 

[*] Recovery after throwing an enemy has been reduced for the Warrior skill "Power Bomb" to make it easier to use in melee combat.

[*] The Magic Arrow magic shot has been adjusted.

[list]
[*] The Magic Arrow was generally superior in all aspects: range, fire rate, and damage, making it a versatile weapon that was not limited by any situation. In addition, its DPS is high compared to other weapons. With this update, we want to emphasize the rapid-fire aspect of the shot to maintain the usability of the weapon, while reducing the effective range and DPS to better outline the strengths and weaknesses of the weapon.

[*] Damage to enemies: 14->11

[*] Fire rate: 500->600

[*] Maximum range:100->85

[list]
[*] Bullet travel decay start distance: 50 -> 35
[/list][/list]
[*] The Fireball magic shot has been adjusted.

[list]
[*] The fire rate and bullet speed of Fireball has been adjusted to improve the accuracy of the weapon and the feeling of impact. All other parameters were also adjusted to match the improved fire rate. In addition, to better emphasize the importance of the immolation effect, hitstun has been eliminated but the increased rate of fire makes it easier to set opposing players on fire.

[*] Damage to enemies: 50⇒40

[*] Damage to objects: 50⇒40

[*] Fire rate: 75⇒100

[*] Immolation: 46⇒36

[*] Enemies will not enter hitstun when hit by fireball.

[*] Bullet speed and homing improved making it easier to strike enemies.
[/list]
[*] Revolver cannon performance adjusted

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where damage was sometimes not done even though it appeared to hit the enemy

[*] Increased bullet speed

[*] Damage to enemies: 35->40

[*] Damage to objects: 36->40

[*] The Revolver Cannon is a weapon that deals a certain amount of damage to both targets and opponents and can flinch opponents, but currently it is difficult to hit enemies with it and has relatively low DPS, leaving it as an underused weapon. Therefore, two adjustments have been made to improve the difficulty of hitting the target and to increase the amount of damage.
[/list]
[*] The effect value of the attack power up buff has been adjusted because the current effect value is low, making it difficult to notice the effect.

[list]
[*] lv1: 1.025->1.05

[*] lv2: 1.05->1.1

[*] lv3: 1.075->1.15

[*] lv4: 1.1->1.2

[*] lv5: 1.125->1.25

[*] lv6: 1.15->1.3

[*] lv7: 1.175->1.35
[/list]
[*] To provide a wider range of customization options and emphasize the effectiveness of temporary buffs, we have adjusted the amount and duration of the buff effects for currently under-utilized Mythic Perks.

[list]
[*] Effect degree

[list]
[*] Nightstalker's Blade Buff lv. 2->3

[*] Nightstalker's Speed Buff lv. 3->4

[*] Duelist's Blade Buff lv. 2->3

[*] Duelist's Speed Buff lv. 3->4

[*] Vengeant Blade Buff lv. 1->2

[*] Vengeant Speed Buff lv. 2->3

[*] Vanguard's Blade Buff lv. 1->2

[*] Vanguard's Speed Buff lv. 2->3

[*] Summoner's Blade Buff lv. 1->2

[*] Summoner's Speed Buff lv. 2->3

[*] Flagbearer's Blade Buff lv. 1->2

[*] Flagbearer's Speed Buff lv. 2->4
[/list]
[*] Effect duration

[list]
[*] Nightstalker's Blade 10s->7s

[*] Nightstalker's Speed 13s->11s

[*] Duelist's Blade 13s->9s

[*] Duelist's Speed 17s->15s

[*] Vengeant Blade 4s->3s

[*] Vengeant Speed 5s->7s

[*] Vanguard's Blade 5s->7s

[*] Vanguard's Speed 7s->13s

[*] Summoner's Blade 5s->4s

[*] Flagbearer's Blade 30s->26s
[/list][/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that sometimes occurred when joining Barrage during a dash where the Barrage would be canceled.

[*] Fixed an issue where the battle banner was not displayed when the outer gate was destroyed.

[*] Fixed an issue where the HP gauges of battering rams, siege towers, and robots were not displayed.

[*] Fixed an issue in 5-Army Battles in which the banner for defeating all enemies in your castle was incorrectly displayed when a Squad joined an opposing army.

[*] Fixed a bug that caused protection armor placed on a siege tower with the Protection skill to remain floating in the air when the tower was moved.

[*] Fixed an issue that prevented some users from seeing their friends when they opened their friend list for the first time.

[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: 🌟 Addressing recent discussions in the Community 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

Thank you so much for all of the support you have shown to Warlander. Your feedback has been incredibly valuable to us, and we're committed to addressing these topics.

We hear your feedback, and agree that getting new players into the game is a priority. We believe that there are things that need to improve within the game to make sure that when new players join they have a good time, and play for longer.
[h2]New Player Experience[/h2]
These past few weeks a lot of our focus has been set on the new player experience. Their first impression is important, so we've dedicated significant effort recently toward enhancing features such as the Tutorial and Matchmaking to ensure that new players aren't overwhelmed by more seasoned players.
[h2]Quality of Life (QoL) improvements[/h2]
To address the feedback for QoL improvements within the game, we first want to clarify that the teams working on expanding the game's content and adding new Maps are distinct from the teams dedicated to adding QoL improvements such as UI and Balancing. Both are important and we're committed to enhancing the gameplay experience on all aspects.

Regarding the priority of these topics, we hear your feedback and we’re making adjustments internally to shift our efforts to QoL improvements.

Previously, a lot of our effort has been set on the Arena mode, to make sure it is a fun experience when it's released. Now that Arena Mode is nearing completion this team now has more time to focus on QoL improvements, such as Renaming Characters which was released recently.
[h2]Upcoming Features / Changes[/h2]
We're actively developing some of the most requested features based on your feedback, and we're excited to provide you with updates on our progress.
[h3]CrossParty[/h3]
CrossParty is a significant focus for us, We've taken your frustrations and feedback seriously. Implementing CrossParty functionality is a complex feature and we’re working tirelessly to get this to you as soon as possible. We're currently aiming for CrossParty to be implemented This Season.
[h3]Voice Chat[/h3]
We've been working on finding the best way to make Voice Chat and Communication work within Warlander considering the team sizes. We're planning on releasing this together with CrossParty.
[h2]Known Issues we’re looking into[/h2]
We have heard your frustrations of issues within the game recently, and are working to address these. Some notable Issues that we’re working on are:
•    [strike]Melee Combat/Collision[/strike] (Fixed on 11. Sep.)
•    [strike]Hymn of War[/strike] (Fixed on 15. Sep.)
•    Reserved Matchmaking Issues
•    Changing brightness bug
[h2]Q&A Answers[/h2]
Thank you for all of the questions you guys have sent in during the Q&A and we apologize for the wait you’ve had to endure during this time.

These questions sparked a lot of conversations internally and provoked a change in our timeline and priorities to make this game the best it can be. Unfortunately this meant, many of the answers to your questions which were already in progress had become either obsolete all-together or required significant editing.

Therefore the Q&A answers will be run out in two parts, as we want to answer as many of your questions as possible, and as quickly as possible. The first part will come out later this season.

notes.title: 🌟 Replacing Sentry Anti-Cheat with Denuvo 🌟
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

Next Week, Warlander's Steam version will begin with testing the anti-cheat software "Denuvo" in the user environment.

The intention, if all goes to plan, is to replace Sentry entirely with Denuvo.

During the test, both Denuvo and Sentry will be running.

The Sentry launcher may be turned off, but [b]this does not mean that Sentry is uninstalled.[/b]

After the test, if we make the final decision whether to implement Denuvo over Sentry or not, [b]we will publish the procedure for uninstalling Sentry again.[/b]

Denuvo will need to be installed once it's been implemented.

The following is an FAQ regarding the introduction of Denuvo.

If you're having any issues during this trial period, don't hesitate to reach out to our player support:
https://to.plaion.com/WarlanderSupport


[h2]How does Denuvo work?[/h2]

Denuvo, like other anti-cheat services monitors a player’s game and detects unauthorized use of third-party programs or modifications.

[h2]Does Denuvo affect game performance?[/h2]

Denuvo anti-cheat solution does not interfere with the regular operation of the game and does not cause errors or reduce stability to system performance.

[h2]Do I need to install Denuvo?[/h2]

Denuvo is installed with the user's permission the first time the Denuvo-supported Warlander is launched.

[h2]Can I uninstall Denuvo?[/h2]

Yes, you can uninstall Denuvo with the standard Windows features.

However, if you launch Warlander after uninstalling Denuvo, you will be prompted to re-install it; playing Warlander will require Denuvo to be installed.

[h2]What is the Anti-Cheat SDK? / How does it work?[/h2]

Anti-cheat SDK solution secures online gameplay mechanics that reward offline progress. 

It protects sensitive game logic and data, prevents cheaters from changing a sensitive variable, such as decrypting saved games or modifying network traffic, and also provides protection against the most common cheat tools.

[h2]Is anti-cheat software in kernel mode safe?[/h2]

Running the driver component in kernel-mode can raise concerns, but kernel-level access is needed to detect cheaters effectively. 

It’s worth mentioning that the most popular multiplayer games have adopted kernel-mode anti-cheat for effective protection.

Read more here about kernel access and games that use this: 
https://blog.irdeto.com/video-gaming/denuvo-anti-cheat-why-we-chose-to-use-a-windows-kernel-mode-driver-in-our-solution/

notes.title: 🌟 Season 2 Release Notes! 🌟
notes.content:
[h1]Release Notes[/h1]

[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]

[list]
[*] With the start of Season 2, a new Season Pass with new Glamours and profile banners is here!

[*] A new Tier 5 Title for Warriors, Soul Eater, has been added.

[list]
[*] The Ult Skill Cursed Sword can kill an enemy with a single blow if the attack is made within 6 seconds of activation. if the enemy is killed within 6 seconds, the duration is reset.
[/list]
[*] An overtime system has been implemented for the 2 Army and 5 Army Battle Modes.

[list]
[*] If a Battle ends with the remaining Core HP for 2 or more armies being identical, there will be 5 minutes of overtime.

[*] During overtime, Core will have 5% HP and all castle gates will be destroyed and cannot be rebuilt.[/list]
[*] Added feature to select armor type.

[list]
[*] Each armor type can be equipped with different equipment and Glamours.

[*] Each armor type has its own characteristics and slightly different basic performance.
[/list]
[*] A Matchmaking Reservation system has been implemented to match more players at once.

[list]
[*] While using Matchmaking reservation, you can edit your character and customization options until you find a match.

[*] Matchmaking will be adjusted in real time as needed based on the number of active users and the Ranked Status of players at any given time.
[/list]
[*] New Titles have been added.

[list]
[*] Warrior
[list]
[*] Tier 1 Challenger: +2.5% Damage to Superior Foes
[*] Tier 2 Rebel: +5% Damage to Superior Foes
[*] Tier 3 Scoundrel: +24% Ladder Climbing Speed
[*] Tier 3 Bombardier: +22.5% Damage inflicted from Siege Weapons
[*] Tier 4 Dreadnought: +30% Damage inflicted from Siege Weapons
[*] Tier 4 Outlaw Hero: +32% Ladder Climbing Speed
[/list]
[*] Cleric
[list]
[*] Tier 1 Indomitable: +2.5% Damage to Superior Foes
[*] Tier 2 Recusant: +5% Damage to Superior Foes
[*] Tier 3 Mendicant: +150% Tower Capture Speed
[*] Tier 3 Inquisitor: +7.5% Damage to Mages
[*] Tier 4 Exorcist: +10% Damage to Mages
[*] Tier 4 Liberator: +200% Tower Capture Speed
[/list]
[*] Mage
[list]
[*] Tier 1 Curmudgeon: +2.5% Damage to Superior Foes 
[*] Tier 2 Insurgent: +5% Damage to Superior Foes 
[*] Tier 3 Deadeye: +11.25% Headshot Power
[*] Tier 3 Strategist: +150% Tower Capture Speed
[*] Tier 4 Evil eye: +15% Headshot Power
[*] Tier 4 Mastermind: +200% Tower Capture Speed
[/list][/list]
[*] New perks added
[list]
[*] Aim Move Speed Up
[*] Jump Attack Power Up
[/list]
[*] New talents added
[list]
[*] Critical Slash Range UP
[*] Piloted Weapon Reload Speed Up
[*] Object Move Up
[/list]
[*] New stamps have been added

[*] Character names can now be changed in the Customize avatar screen

[*] NVIDIA Image Scaling has been added to the Options screen

[*] Out-game tutorials can now be redisplayed on each screen

[*] Core HP percentages are now always displayed on the screen
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The bonus points earned by the winning team will no longer be factored into the player/squad ranking within the result. Instead, they will be accounted for as experience points in the season's result.

[*] Adjusted the meteors in Ritual Valley A and B, which were stuck on the cliffs and difficult to fall down.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Cataclysm Tornado to get caught on minor bumps and stop.
[*] Fixed a bug where the customization cost of a Legendary weapon was sometimes not accounted for in the total cost.
[*] Fixed a bug where the idol icon would sometimes be positioned outside the display range on the minimap.
[*] Fixed a bug where an ally's Barrier would not prevent an enemy's Thundershock.
[*] Fixed a bug where Orichalcum raked players would momentarily display an aura icon when entering the friend ranking.
[*] Fixed a bug where the cool time of the last used skill would not advance when joining a team skill.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[*] Details of specific skills and Talents can now be toggled on or off on the product details screen of the Shop and the reward details screen of the Season Pass.
[*] Changed when Deploy Points are earned in Arena Mode.
[list]
[*] Players now receive 3 Deploy Points before the start of round 1, then 2 points at the beginning of each round afterward. [/list]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the kill sound effect from occurring. Also adjusted the kill sound effect.

[list]

[*] Fixed a problem that sometimes prevented correct key input on keyboard.
[*] On keyboard, some additional keys are now available to have inputs set to them.

notes.title: ⚔️ PATCH 1.6.0.1201 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

PATCH 1.6.0.1201 is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/8c09f64fe5f76972cd525bf38d66f43bbfb5e8df.png[/img]

[h2]New Cleric Skill: Divine Hammer[/h2]
[list]
[*] This Skill builds up power into the user’s hammer, and then slams it all down in a powerful blow that blasts all surrounding enemies away while also restoring HP to allies.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=E7ooLnC4n7A;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Clerics can now Parry![/h2]
[list]
[*] Clerics can now Parry by double tapping the shield button. If an enemy hits the Cleric as they Parry, the Cleric will perform a counterattack.
[/list]
[h2]Custom Lobbies for Events[/h2]
[list]
[*] This feature is intended for use in events and competitions and is not currently open to the public.
[*] Currently only basic features are implemented with more on the way, including spectator and distribution features.
[*] Custom Match access can be requested by completing our Event Proposal application https://to.plaion.com/WarlanderCommunityEventProposal Full details and use instructions provided upon approval of the Event Proposal application.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/d8acb615d0c4f325e5c0bf805e949a1c825e354f.png[/img]

[h2]Warp Gate[/h2]
The Cleric Skill Warp Gate can now be destroyed by enemy attacks.

Previously, Warp Gates could only be removed with dispel. By making Warp Gates destructible, there is now more room for counterplay resulting in a greater amount of back-and-forth on the battlefield.

In addition, the duration of the warp gate effect will be extended.
[list]
[*] Lv1 15s → 25s

[*] Lv2 20s → 30s

[*] Lv3 25s → 35s

[*] Lv4 30s → 40s

[*] Lv5 35s → 45s
[/list]
[previewyoutube=zG20cYaumNk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Rank Points[/h2]
Adjustments to rank points and rewards earned in 2-army Battles.
[list]
[*] The lower your Rank, the easier it is to earn Rank Points.
[*] Winning Battles results in earning more Rank Points.
[/list]
[h2]Catapult[/h2]
Adjusted the catapult on the enemy team side in the 2-army Battle Map Moonlit Temple to prevent it from being destroyed by friendly attacks.

[h2]Camera[/h2]
Fixed an issue where the camera moved in an unintended direction when casting skills, making it difficult to operate.

[h2]Settings[/h2]
Improved so that favorite settings can be changed from the details screen of equipment.

[h2]Cover Shot[/h2]
Cover Shot now aims with the sensitivity as when aiming down sights.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/1406e4a0b0ea16e21fca120eea9f12e3d846d732.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Ballista bullets to penetrate super guards in rare cases.

[*] Fixed a bug where training area mode could not be selected after a party broke up.

[*] Fixed a bug where the Building Accuracy perk was sometimes not reflected.

[*] Fixed a bug where armor values for robot pilots were not displayed correctly.

[*] Adjusted critical slash to always point in the target direction.

[*] Fixed a bug where skill cooldowns are not reset when changing characters.

[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

notes.title: 🔮 Community Spotlight - JValTV 🔮
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/68d14b6f68d54da58406d79f34c4e68bad6ecb17.jpg[/img]

[h2]Greetings Warlander![/h2]

Part of the latest wave of top-tier humans (he's really an APE) to play Warlander, JVal is much more than just a skilled veteran player. In-grained in the community as a live stream staple and shot-calling leader of the APE Clan, it's hard to believe that JVal hasn't always been here, guiding us in the game and providing a positive, yet [i]extremely[/i] honest place to discuss Warlander.

But enough from us, let's let JVal do the talking, it's a fantastic read. ːsteamhappyː  

[h1]JValTV Community Spotlight[/h1]

[h2]Who are you?[/h2]
My handle’s JValTV. I’m from all over the United States and a bit of Canada. I’m a sweaty tryhard that gets hard carried by the sweat team called “APES”. A Warlander only team focused on teamwork and sweaty high-level WL play. Our recruitment post is on the official WL discord. 

[h2]How did you come up with your name?[/h2]
My handles have slowly evolved over the years. I can tell when players met me by what they call me. JValTV started here in Warlander. Had to shorten the full handle to be within the visible character limitations. Johnny comes from my BF4 and Arma III days. While Valentine’s my RL nickname. Why Valentine? Because I was terrible at talking to women. Gamer level bad. My teens and twenties, my attempts to be respectful just came across as awkward. I’d get all anxious, wouldn’t be able to speak, it was a class act disaster. 

[h2]How did you find Warlander?[/h2]
Streamers attract streamers. I was researching new games and came across Maliqu. He was rocking his chainmail setup, making icelance look amazing. If you haven’t seen Maliqu play catch him at https://www.twitch.tv/maliqu. I wouldn’t have found this amazing community without him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/651d67be750f8fe2c0e9eb4260527d903d52d946.png[/img]

[h2]What kind of content do you make?[/h2]
I stream for fun and use the footage from streaming to practice video creation. My goal is to be a full-time streamer and to produce X number of videos a week. Lot of time, lot of effort, but the moments when someone pulls a great play (especially against a sweatlord like me) or they learn a “git gud” fact from a video. It feels great. You get a tiny share of a cool experience. 

[h2]Where do you make it?[/h2] 
[h3]Twitch[/h3]
I stream at https://www.twitch.tv/jvaltv. My stream schedule is listed there. Come hang out, feel free to que snipe me (que at the same time I do). I love playing with the community, it keeps the APES and I honest. 

[h3]Youtube[/h3]
My Youtubes: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwx3zCdNUlyimuStDsNgwkA. I do mostly longform content. I may branch into youtube/multi-platform streaming in the future, but for now, it’s a great place to catch Warlander tutorials and sweaty gameplay footage. Those sweat games really show the potential Warlander has. Matches that get your gamer sweat going, that you sign off and think about afterwards and best of all, having that shared experience with your gamer buddies. 

[h2]When did you start making content?[/h2]
I started researching content creation and creating the framework roughly a year ago. I committed and started trial and erroring about 7 to 8 months ago. I started playing Warlander on PC launch day. Have been dedicated to the game ever since. 

[h2]What's your process?[/h2]
For streaming it’s straight forward. Most notable investments being a mic arm and green screen. Mic arm allows you to express yourself a bit more through body language without suffering on audio quality. Green screen is a great investment for cutting out your background and saving that screen space for gameplay. 

For videos, it’s mostly freeware and crutching on youtube tutorials. You can learn just about anything on YT for free. And though taking 3 hours to learn how to create word bubbles in davinci can be an emotional experience... it’s rewarding afterwards to have those tools in your toolkit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[h2]Who inspires you?[/h2] 
I was in the Infantry for seven years. I wouldn’t be a ¼ of the person I am today without the influence from my first squad leader, SGT R. SGT R gave me the tools and behaviors to survive many difficult events and, in the process, learn a lot about myself and life in general. He taught me it’s better to spend every dime you get as a leader investing back into your own team than living on some leadership powertrip. To build the people up around you more than you break them down. That if a leader’s done his job correctly, he’s the most useless person on the crew. A glorified janitor. That the team’s success matters more than you. I owe a lot to that man.

[h2]What inspired you to make content?[/h2]
I did hard and serious work for a long time. Dealing with life and death situations, managing capital in the millions of dollars and all the other laurels of a dangerous vicarial job. From the “thank yous” to the funerals. At some point, I decided I’d prefer a simpler life. I get to play video games and be a team member with fellow players across the entire diversity spectrum. Where nothing else matters about who you are then how well you can work together and take some color’d pixels to the W screen. That is a level of comradery and inclusion hard to find eslewhere without an otherwise steep admission. 

[h2]What is the future of your channel and content?[/h2] 
Starting with season 1, I’ve posted a new stream schedule to better accommodate both the EU and NA viwers. I wish I could crack the language barrier and be more inclusive towards the Asian community. So many great players, great gameplay, and great personalities from that region. Many of which have English translators on their streams, so check them out! While on Youtube, I’m working towards more newbie tutorials and a weekly “best of X season” series. 

[h2]What is your special talent?[/h2]
I’m lucky. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/31f526ad0efd8c4280b4cf6d039bdbd9de407ace.png[/img]

[h2]What is something that no one knows about you?[/h2] 
I took a year after service and went nomadic. Lived out of my vehicle. Added extra storage and solar, got rid of lot of my extra house junk and just traveled. Saved up a little nest egg during COVID working some extreme overtime and then spent a few months destination and beach hopping while knocking out some online learning. It was honestly an amazing experience and I often miss it. Wild how much time and energy gets spent to pay for a box that you end up only sleeping in.

[h2]What are your goals?[/h2]
To be a full-time content creator. To be a good person. To provide a product that brings people joy. To sleep soundly at night. To laugh and make others laugh. To make others feel more proud, more confident and to be a fly on the wall for their success. To support as many people as I can who are trying to achieve the same. 

[h2]What is your favorite thing you’ve made?[/h2]
My favorite product earns my channel absolutely nothing. There is no external gain from it. In fact, it’s a net loss for me due to the time expense. But I love my channels twitch clips. When the community has an outplay on the APES and myself and posts us getting clowned on. When you see that solo player rise-up and become a champion of the match and those views spike up. That’s super cool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[h2]What has been your most memorable moment in Warlander?[/h2]
Elysian, another great WL team, que-sniped my stream one night and that was my first Warlander experience of sweaty team play. There was meta and counter meta, strategic and tactical outplays. And we’d win or lose, palms sweaty and laugh about how much fun it was. That was the moment I knew that I loved this game. That I’d risk my time and effort on its potential because there’s cool stuff under the hood here. Yeah, it needs polish, balancing and creature comforts but the frame of this game, especially for F2P, is wildly good.

[h2]What is your favorite Class?[/h2]
Because I play in a sweaty team environment, we don’t look at class ideology the same. Decks are separated into 5 types. Main Heal, DPS, Utility, Pusher and Hybrid. There’s also a less talked about 6th Deck called “Rank”. Each deck design serves a certain role within the matches/teamplay and may include various classes. My favorite deck is probably Main Heal. I dream about playing Utility Deck. But, I mostly play Main Pusher. 

[h2]What does your current deck setup consist of?[/h2]
I play a “pusher” for the APES. My job is to take ground, contest points and take hits for the rest of the squad. My deck currently has 4 Warriors and 1 Portal Cleric. The detail of the setup depends on the patch version. In general, I use a knock/barrier zero-star warrior, since it’s good all game. Health stacked warriors at various titles, so give my healers more value from their heals and a portal/wall/climb cleric to keep the enemy team honest. 

[h2]What advice would you give a new player?[/h2]
Being new in an established pvp game is difficult. Class, map, and general game mechanic knowledge is extremely powerful stuff. My recommendation is to watch the various WL streamers and ask questions in their chat. Pick their brains. Watch WL videos from active Warlandians. They have a lot of knowledge to share.

Join the Official discord @https://discord.gg/playwarlander. The voice system on that server is amazing, the chats are a great place to get questions answered and find players to group with. Make friends, seriously, little extra teamwork makes the dream work.

Check out the Warlander wiki for any detail-level info you’re looking for. Content creators can’t make videos about this stuff because it outdates too quickly. So, the wiki is great for hyper-specific information.  https://warlander.fandom.com/wiki/Warlander_Wiki. Big shoutout to Hemoura, Gwendoline and crew for their hard work as wiki editors.

[h2]What advice would you give to a new Warlander Content Creator?[/h2]
The streamer to viewership saturation in WL is very favorable for new streamers trying to build their initial audience. The community is incredibly friendly, which gives you a chance to practice your craft and see if content creation is something you enjoy. Because end of the day, it’s still work. Figure out your brand. Find your niche, WL have tons of unfilled content creation niches and just focus on making better content than you made yesterday. And if you do that, the other WL streamers will make the effort to support you. We take care of our own. 

[h2]What do you enjoy most about Warlander and what do you look forward to the most in the future?[/h2]
The Community, hands down. We don’t always agree, especially about balancing or how to lobby for our preferred changes. At the end of the day, there’s a lot of players that love this game. And it’s that love of play that is our great mutual commonality. Good patch, bad patch, bug or tyranny of a meta. I’m always looking forward to that next GG.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: ⚔️ Small Patch - No Version Change ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

We've pushed a small patch today to all platforms, details are below:

[h2]Feature Improvements[/h2]
[b]The transition time from one screen to the next as well as the overall time for the War Strategy meeting phase has been shortened.[/b]

[h2]Parameter Adjustments[/h2]
[b]Adjustments will be made to Centurion's ULT Skill "Colossus Form".[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the duration of Colossus Form from 12s to 15s.

[*] When Colossus Form is activated, the max HP increase is now increased from 150 to 300.
 
[*] Attack power increase in increased from 1.2x to 1.3x.
 
[*] Shortened the recovery time after activating Colossus and Roar.
[/list]
The goal of the Colossus Ult is to strengthen the Warrior’s role as a tank by temporarily increasing the HP limit and attracting the attention of enemy players. However, in its current state, it was difficult to withstand attacks from multiple enemies, and its ability to survive was poorer than anticipated.

[b]Adjustments to HP for ballistae and cannons.[/b]
[list]
[*] 600 before reinforcement/1200 after reinforcement → 540 before reinforcement /1080 after reinforcement
[/list]
This change was made because games were prone to stalemate due to the large impact of anti-siege weapons on the battle situation. In addition, there was little difference in HP between the anti-siege weapons and the defensive parameters, making it difficult to create a choice of which to destroy depending on the situation.

notes.title: ⚔️ PATCH 1.5.0.1180 ⚔️
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Warlander![/b]

[h2]Welcome to Season 1[/h2]
PATCH 1.5.0.1180 is now live! 

[h2]Change Log[/h2]

[h3]Functional Additions[/h3]
New title "Inferno" and new ultimate "Phoenix" will be added.
The new title "Inferno" is a Legendary title that strengthens flame attacks, and is also applied to dedicated Familiars, enabling them to destroy weapons with their flame attacks.

The "Phoenix" skill is a powerful ultimate that releases a fire-bird into the sky, detonating it in mid-air and bombarding the battlefield. It can inflict fire damage over a wide area.

[h3]New titles will be added[/h3]
[b]Warrior[/b]
[list]
[*] Plunderer (Title Rank 2)
[*] Title effect: When in an enemy castle, gains attack power buff Lv.2
[*] Subjugator (Title rank 3)
[*] Title effect: When in an enemy castle, gains attack power buff Lv.3
[*] Conqueror (Rank 4)
[*] Title effect: When in an enemy castle, gains attack power buff Lv.4
[/list]

[b]Cleric[/b]
[list]
[*] Chandler (rank 2)
[*] Title effect: Buffs attack power Lv.2 when in range of a tower
[*] Lightkeeper (Rank 3)
[*] Title effect: Buffs attack power Lv.3 when in range of a tower
[*] The Radiant (Title Rank 4)
[*] Title effect: Buffs attack power Lv.4 when in range of a tower
[/list]

[b]Mage[/b]
[list]
[*] Scribe (Title rank 2)
[*] Title effect: When in your castle, gain attack power buff Lv.2
[*] Royal Mage (Rank 3)
[*] Title effect: When in your castle, gain attack power buff Lv.3
[*] Chancellor (Rank 4)
[*] Title effect: When in your castle, gain attack power buff Lv.4
[/list]

[h3]New perks will be added[/h3]
[b]Weapon of Warrior/Cleric[/b]
[list]
[*] Strengthens rear attack
[/list]

[b]Shield of Warrior/Cleric[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire Defense / Lightning Defense / Wind Defense / Ice Defense
[/list]

[b]Familiar[/b]
[list]
[*] Strengthening of fire attack/lightning attack/wind attack/ice attack
[/list]

[h3]New talents will be added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guard movement speed up
[*] Ladder climbing speed up
[*] Enhanced headshot
[*] Critical Slash Attack Power Up
[*] Increased load capacity
[*] Enhanced boarding weapon attack
[/list]

[h3]Functional Improvements[/h3]
The search time for matching players of the same rank will be extended to make it easier to match with players of similar ranks.

The calculation of rank points earned and the number of rank points required for each rank will be adjusted so that ranks will be more proportional to player skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[h2]Console Version Release Date and Time[/h2]
The PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X|S versions of Warlander will be released on [b]Tuesday, May 16, 2023 at 00:00 AM (Per Regional Timezone)[/b]. 

Cross-play will be supported on all platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

Thanks for your continued love and support.

The "Phoenix" skill is a powerful ultimate that releases a fire-bird into the sky, detonating it in mid-air and bombarding the battlefield. It can inflict fire damage over a wide area.

[b]Warrior[/b]
[list]
[*] Plunderer (Title Rank 2)
[*] Title effect: When in an enemy castle, gains attack power buff Lv.2
[*] Subjugator (Title rank 3)
[*] Title effect: When in an enemy castle, gains attack power buff Lv.3
[*] Conqueror (Rank 4)
[*] Title effect: When in an enemy castle, gains attack power buff Lv.4
[/list]

[b]Cleric[/b]
[list]
[*] Chandler (rank 2)
[*] Title effect: Buffs attack power Lv.2 when in range of a tower
[*] Lightkeeper (Rank 3)
[*] Title effect: Buffs attack power Lv.3 when in range of a tower
[*] The Radiant (Title Rank 4)
[*] Title effect: Buffs attack power Lv.4 when in range of a tower
[/list]

[b]Mage[/b]
[list]
[*] Scribe (Title rank 2)
[*] Title effect: When in your castle, gain attack power buff Lv.2
[*] Royal Mage (Rank 3)
[*] Title effect: When in your castle, gain attack power buff Lv.3
[*] Chancellor (Rank 4)
[*] Title effect: When in your castle, gain attack power buff Lv.4
[/list]

[h3]New perks will be added[/h3]
[b]Weapon of Warrior/Cleric[/b]
[list]
[*] Strengthens rear attack
[/list]

[b]Shield of Warrior/Cleric[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire Defense / Lightning Defense / Wind Defense / Ice Defense
[/list]

[b]Familiar[/b]
[list]
[*] Strengthening of fire attack/lightning attack/wind attack/ice attack
[/list]

[h3]New talents will be added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guard movement speed up
[*] Ladder climbing speed up
[*] Enhanced headshot
[*] Critical Slash Attack Power Up
[*] Increased load capacity
[*] Enhanced boarding weapon attack
[/list]

[h3]Functional Improvements[/h3]
The search time for matching players of the same rank will be extended to make it easier to match with players of similar ranks.

The calculation of rank points earned and the number of rank points required for each rank will be adjusted so that ranks will be more proportional to player skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42927751/f312deb64c40d62e001e9628fce24857827a3652.png[/img]

[h2]Console Version Release Date and Time[/h2]
The PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X|S versions of Warlander will be released on [b]Tuesday, May 16, 2023 at 00:00 AM (Per Regional Timezone)[/b].   

Cross-play will be supported on all platforms.
